result.stdout:
usage: aztree [-h] [--version] [--demo] [--subscription ID_OR_NAME | --all |
              --scope SCOPE] [--days DAYS]
              [--metric {ActualCost,AmortizedCost}] [--no-advisor] [--tag KEY]
              [--no-graph] [--from [JSON]] [--out OUT] [--no-open]
              [--export [FILE]] [--verbose]

See where your Azure money goes, as a treemap.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --demo                use fake data (no Azure access needed)
  --subscription ID_OR_NAME
                        subscription to read, repeat for more (default: the
                        Azure CLI's current one)
  --all                 read every enabled subscription you can see
  --scope SCOPE         any Cost Management scope, e.g. a billing account (not
                        tested yet)
  --days DAYS           period to show, compared with the period before it
                        (default 30)
  --metric {ActualCost,AmortizedCost}
                        AmortizedCost spreads reservation and savings plan
                        purchases over their term
  --no-advisor          skip Azure Advisor's cost recommendations
  --tag KEY             tag for the tag view (default: the tag on the most
                        resources)
  --no-graph            skip the Resource Graph checks for idle resources
  --from [JSON]         reopen saved data without calling Azure (default: the
                        last run)
  --out OUT             where to write the page (default
                        ~/.aztree/aztree.html)
  --no-open             don't open the browser
  --export [FILE]       write a summary JSON for an AI agent (default
                        ~/.aztree/aztree-export.json) instead of the page
  --verbose             print pages, rows and query units per request
